summary.en: Docker command-line client and static binaries. The winget manifest lists an aarch64 Windows zip from download.docker.com.
summary.zh-TW: Docker 命令列用戶端，winget 清單提供 download.docker.com 的 Windows aarch64 壓縮檔。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
